frontend._note: package = the WSI viewer package and the Pathology Slides tab only (image-ID access; hideable slide list and details panels; collapsible details sections; a Clinical section of the study's default, populated clinical attributes; the tab shows when the patient's slide hierarchy has slides, or when it is the active tab). Every child contains the package pin; agent contains annotations (the annotations-agent matrix row checks out agent and requires annotations as an ancestor); integration = package + study + patient + molecular + agent + studySlides. studySlides = the study-view Pathology Slides tab; it needs the backend child in backendChildren.studySlides (not the pinned backend), and its browser contract (wsi-study-slides-mocked.spec.ts) mocks the study and WSI APIs. Known gap: the patient child (clinical-event loading, hierarchy-built pathology timeline track, undated notice counted from the same hierarchy, tab link scoping) has no Playwright spec; its browser contract is wsi-foundation-mocked.spec.ts and its behaviour is covered by its Jest specs (pathologySlidesTimeline, pathologySlidesTimelineLoader, PatientWsiSlidesTab, UndatedPathologySlidesNotice, WsiPatientViewRoute).
